rationale: Resolve every primary state and extensive exchange to 0.1 percent of an input-defined physical scale; this is a numerical engineering requirement, not experimental uncertainty or a fitted threshold. Keep the existing NP phase requirement. Demonstrate convergence and separately bound reference and temporal errors. Subsequent periodic-output qualification may tighten, never silently relax, these requirements.
energy_scale: mass_scale*cv_air(700K)*700K; formation energy is excluded from the normalization, not from the balance
phase_operator: Compare same identified isolated extremum and interior zero crossing, with no phase shifting. Bound temporal sampling uncertainty separately; a flat/nonunique extremum has no phase claim and must be assessed by its full waveform, not assigned a convenient time.
failure: Refine or diagnose; do not expand these thresholds because a candidate or reference misses them.
